ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var inputPayload = vars.inputPayload default {} --- inputPayload -- ["type", "analytics", "validations"]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- (vars.inputPayload.analytics default false) as Boolean

%dw 2.0 output application/java var ofertas = payload.OfertasSugeridas default [] --- (ofertas flatMap ((oferta) -> (oferta.Acciones default []) flatMap ((accion) -> (accion.ParametrosCadena default []) filter ((p) -> upper(p.Llave default "") == "ID") flatMap ((p) -> p.Valor default []) ) )) distinctBy $

logger.doc:name: Log analitica failure
logger.message: #["Analitica ofertasSugeridas failed or empty; continuing with PROM_Promociones_Fija. detail=" ++ (vars.errorMessageOutput default error.description default "")]
